description:
Location: New York City (hybrid) · Team: Engineering


ABOUT ALCHEMI

It takes more than a decade and over $2 billion to bring a new drug to market. A lot of that time is spent writing, reviewing and defending documentation in regulated environments where mistakes are expensive and speed is hard to come by.

Alchemi builds AI agents for that work. Our platform drafts regulatory documents from a team's own templates and runs QC and QA review against the guidelines and SOPs that govern a study, inside a single-tenant, GxP-compliant environment that never trains on customer data. We already work with three of the top five pharma companies and a number of Tier 1 CROs.


THE ROLE

Every agent we ship runs on the same AI layer: how documents, tables and images get into the model, which model handles which step, how every output is checked and traced, and what it all costs. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, AI to own that layer.

Our agent developers build customer workflows on top of what you build. Your job is to make those agents more accurate, faster to build and cheaper to run, in an environment where a customer's quality team has to be able to trust and explain every output.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the agent runtime every workflow uses: tool calling, orchestration, context management and the model layer.

 - Make our agents read real pharma documents: PDFs, Word reports, Excel exports, chromatograms and charts, including reports that run past 1,000 pages.

 - Choose and route models for each step, and keep quality, latency and cost in balance as models change.

 - Build guardrails, provenance and traceability so every output can be explained to an auditor.

 - Work with our data engineering team so every change to the AI layer is measured against real customer evals before it ships.

 - Set the patterns, reviews and standards the rest of the team builds on.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of software engineering, including shipping LLM-powered systems to production that real users depend on.

 - Deep Python and strong system design. You've owned something other engineers build on.

 - Hands-on experience with retrieval, document understanding or multimodal models.

 - A rigorous approach to evaluation and reliability. You can explain how you know a change made things better, not just different.

 - Fluency with agentic development: specs first, context deliberately curated, agents used with a verification loop.

 - Curiosity about the science. You don't need a bioanalytical background, but you need to want one.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with scientific, clinical or other regulated data.

 - Document AI or OCR on tables, charts and scanned content.

 - Experience optimizing the cost and latency of LLM workloads at scale.


HOW WE WORK

Small team, low process, high trust. Two-week release cadence, design specs reviewed carefully, and an active resistance to ticket sprawl. Based in New York City, with daily overlap across a team that spans Pacific Time to Western Europe.


WHY JOIN

Our goal is to cut years off drug development timelines. Alchemi has already supported more than 4,500 studies for the top development teams in pharma. We're a small team of experts and we keep talent density high.

 - Impact: Your work goes straight into the regulated workflows that decide how fast drugs reach patients.

 - Excellence: Work alongside a highly skilled team in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

 - Ownership: Help shape product direction, how we work and what we build next.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Salary and equity: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, with options weighted toward ownership if that's what you want.

 - Health: Best-in-class health and dental insurance.

 - Time off: 4 weeks of paid vacation plus public holidays, paid sick leave and parental leave.

 - Location: Based in New York City.

 - Equipment: A MacBook, external monitor and accessories.


HOW TO APPLY

Interested in building the future of drug development with us? We'd love to hear from you. Diversity and inclusion are core to our mission. If you're part of an underrepresented group, we strongly encourage you to apply.

We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.
